defs.def: a greater interest in or desire for sb/sth than sb/sth else 偏爱；爱好；喜爱

ex.s: AI also significantly enhances the educational value of museums, particularly for children and families. _____39_____ For instance, interactive exhibits powered by AI can adjust their content and difficulty level based on the user's preferences and responses.
ex.t: 人工智能还显著提升了博物馆的教育价值，对儿童和家庭尤其如此。____ 例如，由人工智能驱动的互动展品可以根据用户的偏好和反应调整内容和难度。

ex.s: Writing is a matter of personal preferences.

ex.t: 往往他们最终会用小石子填满这片区域，并用化学药剂来除草。

ex.s: She always has an immediate answer for any question I put to her, and even uses my answers to learn more about my preferences.
ex.t: 对于我向她提出的任何问题，她总是能立刻给出答案，甚至利用我的回答来更多地了解我的喜好。

ex.s: Sharing platforms collect personal information about almost every part of our lives, including our names, locations, bank information, and individual preferences for goods and services.
ex.t: 共享平台收集有关我们生活几乎每个方面的个人信息，包括我们的名字、位置、银行信息以及对商品和服务的个人偏好。

ex.s: Talk about music preferences 1 Before you listen, discuss the question in groups.
ex.t: 谈论音乐偏好 1 在你听之前，分组讨论这个问题。

ex.s: Talking about preferences Would you prefer doing …?
ex.t: 谈偏好 你更愿意做……吗？

ex.s: Your home will also learn your daily routine and preferences, so everything will be ready for you when you get home each evening.
ex.t: 你的家还会学习你的日常作息和偏好，这样每天晚上你回到家时一切都会为你准备好。

defs.def: a thing that is liked better or best 偏爱的事物；最喜爱的东西

ex.s: One theory, increasingly ____14____  (support) by experts, suggests that smell preferences are learned.
ex.t: 一种理论，越来越多地____14____  (support)得到专家支持，认为气味偏好是后天习得的。

ex.s: However, new studies have shown that dogs can read human behaviour and have a preference to people who are more friendly or generous with food.
ex.t: 我擦掉窗户上的灰尘以便更好地看清里面。
